text_block_list.text:
Do you mean it? Like... really, really mean
it?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A

text_block_list.text: Haha! You bet! Wanna pinky swear on it?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B

text_block_list.text: Pinky swear? What's that?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't know? Well, you see... we
put our little fingers together
like this...
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B

text_block_list.text:
Then you gotta say, "Cross my heart and
hope to die." It's like a
magic spell to
make sure we keep our promise! Got it?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child B

text_block_list.text:
A magic spell... I got it! Okay—one, two,
three!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child A

text_block_list.text:
Cross my heart and hope to die. Together
forever, you and I!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Children

text_block_list.text: Several years later...
Come on, Dia! Hurry up!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Slow down, Kita!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
But we'll be tardy if we don't pick up the
pace! Seriously, how can it
be this late
already?!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Well, of course we're late! You went into
Friendly Neighborhood Kita
mode, after
all.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
First you helped that old lady with her
bags, then there was that lost
kid... And
let's not forget how you cheered up that
lonely old man.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I-I mean I couldn't just ignore them! But I
guess we'd better make a
run for it...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Ah—wait, Kita! Look over there!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: What is it?! Is someone in trouble?
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
There are stones bouncing all along the
river's surface! Do those boys
have psychic
powers?!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Oh, honestly... They're just skipping
stones! You know, I think your
curiosity
might be another thing slowing us down
here...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, no more distractions! Let's keep
moving—we've got people
to meet!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
...And now, for the benefit of our new
students, allow me to reiterate
the
purpose of today's race.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Looks like we made it just in time!
Thank goodness!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Shh! The student council president has
already begun her speech.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
What does it mean to run at Tracen
Academy? In order to discover
the answer
firsthand, all of you who have yet to debut
are invited to
witness a special event—a
welcome race, so to speak.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That said, it is bona fide race featuring a
coterie of exceptionally
gifted runners
clad in their racewear. I look forward to
hearing your
thoughts and impressions
afterward.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Prez! Let us take over from here!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Ah! That voice...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, someone's certainly eager. In
that case, come show
everyone exactly
how we chase our dreams.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep ya waiting! I'm none other
than Токай Тэйо—the
strongest racer ever!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Like my new racewear? It's like
I'm a blazing fire on the
track! Pretty cool,
huh? ♪
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable. The president was still
talking, you know? How hungry
for
attention can you be?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I could ask you the same thing, McQueen.
I bet you'd kill for some
spotlight too.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: That new racewear of yours is pretty stylish. Sure ya don't wanna flaunt it a little?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Wha... That's none of your concern! And I
have no need to show
off—everyone's eyes
will be on me regardless.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's more like it. But I won't lose
to you, McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Ohh... McQueen is so cool...
Isn't this
great, Kita? Your beloved Teio is right
there in front of you!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: O-oh, yeah... Teio's super cool. In fact, she's almost... too cool...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the fanfare! Kita, the race is
starting!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
(And so, the race begins. The other
Umamusume are all fast, but Teio
and
McQueen are in a league of their own!)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Our racers are approaching the final
stretch as Мэдзиро МакКуин
maintains a
sizeable lead! What a show of power!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
But what's this? Токай Тэйо is hot on her
heels! Токай Тэйо is closing
the distance!
She's just two—no, one length away!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
They're neck and neck! Go, Teio!
They're
neck and neck! Go, McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Teio and McQueen

text_block_list.text: (At that moment, I feel a gust of wind.)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
(Teio's so cool, and her running's as
powerful as always. But
somehow...)
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
(McQueen's so wonderful, and her
running's as powerful as always.
But
somehow...)
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: (This time... I feel more inspired than ever!)
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text:
So this is how they chase their dreams—in
a genuine, all-out race.
What a feeling
that must be.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
From this point on, we'll be running just
like them...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
At Академия Тайсен, the school of our
dreams!
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: Brand New Friends
